description: Active students who have not finished a workout in the last N days (7 by default), with name, last workout date and days since, longest absence first. Students who never trained come first. Use it to answer "who disappeared this week?" and then get_student or list_student_sessions for one of them.

days.description: Days without a finished workout, 1 to 30. Default 7.
